description: "An Essay on the Slavery and Commerce of the Human Species, Particularly the African" by Thomas Clarkson is a historical treatise written during the late 18th century. This essential work examines the transatlantic slave trade and its moral implications, arguing against the legitimacy of slavery and advocating for human rights and freedom.
